name: ESO 269-G058 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 269-G058, a dwarf galaxy in the Centaurus group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso269g058-hubble
story: A small galaxy among the Centaurus group's dwarfs, with a prominent dust lane slicing through its center. Its elongated shape hints at a kinship with dwarf ellipticals.

claims.text: ESO 269-G058 is a dwarf galaxy in the Centaurus group
A prominent dust lane slices through the center of ESO 269-G058
Its elongated shape suggests a relationship to dwarf ellipticals
The main body of the galaxy was observed with HST ACS (Karachentsev et al. 2007)
